text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Arima Kinen just ahead, Inari One seems more nervous than I've ever seen her. Despite her anxiety, she's excited to turn the race into her personal festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a soul meant to burn bright, she heads off toward the track, ready to show everyone the soul that'll give her festival its style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap and Super Creek, seeing the change in Inari One, smile fearlessly, ready for the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the biggest festival of the Twinkle Series to begin! The curtains rise on the fate-defining Arima Kinen!
